title: Random Hamiltonian-path preconditioner inequality
statement: For every unit-diagonal SPD B with mu=lambda_min(B), let D_pi be the adjacent conditional-difference matrix along a uniform permutation and P=E[D_pi^T D_pi]. Then P=[(n+1)I-2B+Diag(diag B^2)]/n and P>=mu B^{-1}.
open_objections: The associated fixed-adjacency regression certificate decays to zero in a positive-equicorrelation family and cannot itself prove the RPCD complexity target.
No Lean formalization, priority audit, or outside-human validation exists.
